issues.description: SQL injection vulnerability in searchTodos() function. Direct string interpolation embeds user-supplied 'keyword' parameter without escaping or parameterization in LIKE clause, allowing arbitrary SQL injection attacks.
SQL injection vulnerability in searchTodosByStatus() function. User input directly concatenated into SQL WHERE clause without validation or parameterization, enabling SQL injection attacks.

SQL injection vulnerability in getTodosByUser() function. Template literal with direct string interpolation embeds 'userId' parameter in SQL JOIN clause without parameterization, enabling SQL injection.
Missing input validation in searchTodosByStatus(). Function accepts 'completed' as string parameter but doesn't validate it's a boolean value.
issues.suggestion: Change parameter type to boolean and add validation

issues.description: Missing input validation in searchTodos(). Function doesn't validate keyword length or trim whitespace.
Missing input validation in getTodosByUser(). Function doesn't validate userId format or length.
issues.suggestion: Validate format and add length bounds
